phases.description: Searching, screening, summarising or synthesising prior work.
Formulating research questions, hypotheses or theoretical framing.
Designing methods, instruments, samples or protocols.
Collecting, generating, transcribing or annotating data.
Cleaning, coding, classifying or transforming data.
Statistical or qualitative analysis, and writing or debugging analysis code.
Translating, proofreading or improving language without changing content.
Creating or modifying figures, images or visualisations.
Reviewing other people's manuscripts or proposals.
Abstracts, summaries, slides, press or social media about the work.

output_used.description: The output was discarded or only consulted.
Parts of the output were kept after substantial human revision.
Most of the output was kept, possibly with light editing.

methods.description: Claims or summaries compared with the original sources.
Code or analysis rerun or reproduced independently.
Reviewed by a person with expertise in the topic.
References checked for existence and metadata.
Any other verification, described in the notes.

outcomes.description: The output was correct as checked.
Errors or problems were found and corrected.
The output was not usable and was discarded.

access.description: A model run on the researcher's own hardware.
An AI feature inside another tool (editor, reference manager, IDE).
